steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease a 9-inch pie plate.
Whisk eggs in a large bowl. Stir in milk and flour, then mix in green chiles and cheese. Pour into the prepared pie plate.
Bake in the preheated oven until center is set, about 35 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Green Chile Eggs
raw_recipe.description: Eggs, milk and chopped green chiles combine for a quick-and-easy breakfast or breakfast-as-a-light-dinner casserole.
raw_recipe.name: Green Chile Eggs

review.reviewBody: Very good, but I only used one can of green chilies. I also used light cheese. I topped it with some sour cream cream - perfect for a light meal.

Mini Quiche Hors d'oeuvre -- GREAT!!

I made this recipe as written EXCEPT ... 1 can green chilis instead of 2, and a pie crust. Baked crust first in a 9X13 cake pan, then baked filling as directed on top of crust. Sliced into small squares and served. Wonderful "finger food".

As I was making this recipe it seemed as if there would be way too many green chiles and cheese in it. I was eating it for breakfast si I actually wanted some eggs and not a big glob of green chiles and cheese. I only used one 4oz can of green chiles and about 1.25-1.5 cups of shredded cheddar cheese. I added about a quarter cup of crumbled bacon pieces and a few sprinkles of salt. Didn't use a pie plate but a round Pampered Chef deep dish baker (stoneware) sprayed with vegetable oil. Baked at 375 as directed for 35 mins and it came out Delicious!

Delicious. The only change I made was using fresh roasted hot chilis rather than canned. I used about a cup. Was so delicious! Light and fluffy. I live in higher altitude and had to bake for an additional 10 minutes

I used two full eggs and four egg whites, I left out the flour and I cut the cheese back to 1/4 cup. I did not use the two cans of green chilies, one was more than plenty. This is a good place to start, but I think it would have been better with some chopped vegetables. Cooking it in the oven wasn't necessary. A little butter in the skillet and in five minutes, it was done.

We all loved this EASY healthy recipe. Like another, I omitted the flour - we are trying to eat low carb -. I added 1/2 can of diced tomatoes, drained and some queso fresca. Really great simple recipe. Add what you have on hand and you've created a wonderful meal. Thanks for a great one.

I loved it. It was quick and very easy. I love green chile. 
I used the recipe as printed from memory. I did not print it. The only difference was that I put in the Microware for 4 minutes stirred and returned for 2 more minutes. Let it sit to cool and cut into six slices like pizza. Served on small plates with Ortea Green Sauce and sliced tomatoes. It was great. Later in the day the leftovers were used for burritos. Great Again

This was delicious! with the changes below it had the perfect amount of spice. it had a little heat ,but my 5 and 7 year old were able to enjoy it as well.
I followed the recipe except for these changes:
1 10 oz can of Ro-tel original tomatoes (tomatoes & Chilies) drained instead of the green chilies.
4 strips of bacon chopped
1 1/2 cups of seasoned cheese (I used habanero taco would probably be good too)

I enjoyed this, but Hubs not so much. I skipped the flour and reduced the amount of cheese and chilies significantly to suit our tastes. A cup of cheese and a can of green chiles to just three eggs seemed like overkill to me. I made this in individual au gratin dishes and topped each with sour cream, chopped tomatoes and black olives.

I enjoyed this, but Hubs not so much. I skipped the flour and reduced the amount of cheese and chilies significantly to suit our tastes. A cup of cheese and a can of green chiles to just three eggs seemed like overkill to me. I made this in individual au gratin dishes and topped each with sour cream, chopped tomatoes and black olives.

Necessity is the Mother of Invention. This morning I decided to make this dish. Well, I only had five eggs but as I cracked them, thinking I would substitute a 1/4 cup of oil for the missing egg, however, I found the fifth egg already cracked and threw it away. Two eggs short I used a vegan substitute grind two tablespoon of flax powder mixed with three tablespoons of water each. That worked fine I found I had already used my last green chilies. So I substituted Rotel spicy tomatoes and peppers. I used two cups of Mexican Cheese in lieu of Cheddar. It was fantastic, but I still want to make the real recipe as I am sure it is good.
I made it following the recipe exactly and it came out great!
Made it just as written and loved it! Will definitely make again!
Delicious! Tastes great with fresh tomatoes and avocados on top after cooking.
Perfect for a quick, easy and very good breakfast.

We have chicken so we have so many eggs, this is a perfect way to use up the eggs! 

My son even loved it!
Made it this morning exactly as recipe suggests. It was perfect with our Sunday morning football Bloody Marys. Delicious and simple!
Yum, yum, yum!!
I was a little hesitant to try this recipe, but had some leftover green chilies that needed to used. I was pleasantly surprised with the outcome. I did not use the flour and really didn't miss it.
Good and quick breakfast. Definitely great for last minute breakfast.
